notes.title: Day One
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors

Was lots of fun last night seeing everyone come in and play the game. Was really encouraging to see the emergent gameplay coming through. Particularly on the Twitch stream with Noaksey when everyone was playing I'm the King of the Piggy Face...

Lot's of great feedback coming in also, many thanks for that. 

Was a long night and we all feel super shattered today but was well worth it.

Lots of thanks also to Doc Robtonik who handled all the questions, interviews and other activities really well. Even when not feeling 100%.

Thanks to Skatch and Karl Savant from WASD Radio for a  fun session for their Podcast, we will send links when it arrives later today.

Looking forward to spreading the love over Valentines weekend with more brutal cartoon slayery. 

you stay focused Barbarians!

Ragnor

notes.title: Welcome to the tribe!
notes.content:
Greetings Barbarians!

So nice to have a permanent place to discuss with the community. As you may know we are launching the game on 12th February at 6pm GMT. We will be all playing the game and around to answer questions. If there is something you'd like to know in advance then feel free to start a discussion. 

We have had a lot of support from Twitch and Youtubers so if anyone wants to talk to us about our involvement in streams then drop us a note here or via email at: admin@thrillion.co.uk

We look forward to introducing the game to you next Thursday and hope you all enjoy it. We are looking to the community to help grow the game with us, for example we'd like to know what maps, modes and characters you'd like to see added to the game. 

stay focused barbarians!

Ragnor
